diagnosis: The onUploadCreate hook in the @tus/server instance extracts patientCaseId from client-supplied upload metadata without checking whether the authenticated doctor (req.doctor.id) is assigned to that patient's case. Any physician on the platform can inject or overwrite diagnostic radiology DICOM imagery on other doctors' patient records.
exploit_request:
POST /files HTTP/1.1
Host: imaging.hospital.org
Authorization: Bearer <doctor_token>
Upload-Length: 104857600
